facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: Account Value means accumulated premiums net of expenses, plus credited interest, less monthly deductions.

facts.name: Split-Dollar Agreement Definition
facts.sentence: A Split-Dollar Agreement refers to the separate agreement between the Employer and the Employee governing their respective rights in this policy.

facts.name: Employer's Recoverable Amount Definition
facts.sentence: Employer's Recoverable Amount means the greater of (a) total premiums paid by the Employer or (b) the Account Value at any relevant date, as defined in the Split-Dollar Agreement.

facts.name: Employee's Family Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: Employee's Family Benefit means the death benefit proceeds remaining after payment of the Employer's Recoverable Amount.

facts.name: Rollout Definition
facts.sentence: Rollout means the termination of the split-dollar arrangement and the transfer of policy ownership to the Employee or the Employee's designee.

facts.name: Economic Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: Economic Benefit means the cost of the current life insurance protection allocated to the Employee, reportable as income under IRS PS-58 rates or insurer's published alternative term rates.

facts.name: Minimum Employer Premium
facts.sentence: The minimum premium payment made by the Employer (Owner) is $5,000 per payment.

facts.name: Annual Premium Limit via IRC §7702
facts.sentence: The annual maximum premium payment is governed by IRC §7702.

facts.name: Below MEC Thresholds
facts.sentence: This policy is designed to remain below Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) thresholds.

facts.name: Premium Expense Load
facts.sentence: A premium expense load of 2.0% applies to each premium payment.

facts.name: Reduced Load for Large Cases
facts.sentence: The reduced premium expense load reflects large case economics.

facts.name: Employee No Premium Payment
facts.sentence: The Employee does not pay premiums for the policy.

facts.name: Employee Imputed Income Reporting
facts.sentence: The Employee reports the economic benefit of the term insurance coverage as imputed income on Form W-2.

facts.name: Employee Payment Option
facts.sentence: The Employee may elect to pay the economic benefit cost directly to the Employer to avoid imputed income.

facts.name: Split-Dollar Payment Option
facts.sentence: The option to pay the economic benefit cost directly to the Employer is permitted under the Split-Dollar Agreement.

facts.name: Employee Payment Not Premium Payer
facts.sentence: Electing to pay the economic benefit cost directly to the Employer does not make the Employee a premium payer under this policy.

facts.name: Flexible Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums can be paid flexibly by the Employer.

facts.name: Premium Flexibility Beyond Target
facts.sentence: The Employer may pay additional amounts above the Target Premium.

facts.name: Above-Target Premium Limits
facts.sentence: Additional premium payments above the Target Premium are subject to IRC §7702 corridor limits.

facts.name: Monthly Account Deductions
facts.sentence: On the 4th of each month, a deduction is made from the Account Value.

facts.name: Monthly Deduction Timing
facts.sentence: Deductions from the Account Value occur on the 4th of each month.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Deduction
facts.sentence: One deduction from the Account Value is the Cost of Insurance (COI) charge.

facts.name: Monthly Administrative Fee Deduction
facts.sentence: Another deduction from the Account Value is the Administrative fee of $25.00 per month.

facts.name: Loan Interest Deduction
facts.sentence: A third deduction from the Account Value is outstanding loan interest.

facts.name: COI Rate Basis
facts.sentence: The basis for the Cost of Insurance (COI) rate is the 2017 CSO Preferred Plus Table.

facts.name: Guaranteed COI Rates via Schedule
facts.sentence: Guaranteed maximum COI rates apply according to the COI Schedule.

facts.name: Competitive COI Rates Due to Large Face Amount
facts.sentence: Due to the large face amount of the policy, net COI rates are highly competitive.

facts.name: COI Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance (COI) equals (Option B Net Amount at Risk) multiplied by COI Rate divided by 1,000.

facts.name: Option B Net Amount at Risk Definition
facts.sentence: Option B Net Amount at Risk is equal to the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Account Value Adds to Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Account Value is additive to the death benefit.

facts.name: Specified Amount Always At Risk
facts.sentence: Because Account Value is additive to the death benefit, the Specified Amount is always at risk.

facts.name: Specified Amount Risk Due to Additive Structure
facts.sentence: Specified Amount is always at risk because Account Value is additive to the death benefit.

facts.name: Daily Interest Crediting
facts.sentence: Interest is credited daily.

facts.name: Guaranteed Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Guaranteed minimum annual interest rate is 2.25%.

facts.name: Current Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Current annual interest rate is 5.10%.

facts.name: Large Case Enhancement
facts.sentence: For Account Values above $2,000,000, a Large Case Enhancement of 0.30% per annum is applied.

facts.name: Large Case Enhancement Guarantee
facts.sentence: Guaranteed minimum Large Case Enhancement is 0.10% per annum.

facts.name: Monthly Rate Declaration
facts.sentence: Current interest rate is declared monthly.

facts.name: Guaranteed Rate Always Applies
facts.sentence: Guaranteed minimum interest rate applies at all times.

facts.name: Option B Active
facts.sentence: Option B (Increasing) death benefit is in force.

facts.name: Death Benefit Formula
facts.sentence: Total Death Benefit equals Specified Amount plus Account Value.

facts.name: Employer Recovery Clause
facts.sentence: Upon death, employer receives Employer's Recoverable Amount.

facts.name: Family Proceeds After Death
facts.sentence: Upon death, employee's family receives the remainder of the death benefit proceeds.

facts.name: Minimum Family Benefit Guarantee
facts.sentence: Minimum family benefit guaranteed by Rollout Agreement is $1,000,000.

facts.name: Minimum Family Benefit Duration
facts.sentence: Minimum family benefit guarantee lasts for the first 10 years of the arrangement.

facts.name: Post-Rollout Death Beneficiary Rule
facts.sentence: If death occurs after rollout, ownership is transferred to the employee.

facts.name: Post-Rollover Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: After rollout, all death proceeds go to the employee's designated beneficiaries.

facts.name: Tax Exclusion for Employer Share
facts.sentence: Employer's share of death proceeds is excluded from employer's gross income under IRC §101(a).

facts.name: IRC §101(j) Compliance Requirement
facts.sentence: IRC §101(j) requirements must be satisfied for employer's share to qualify for exclusion.

facts.name: Death Proceeds Exclusion
facts.sentence: Death proceeds from a life insurance policy are excludable from Employer's gross income under Internal Revenue Code Section 101(a) if the conditions specified in IRC §101(j) are met.

facts.name: Owner Exclusive Withdrawal Rights
facts.sentence: Only the Owner (Employer) may exercise withdrawal rights under the Endorsement Method split-dollar arrangement.

facts.name: Employee Withdrawal Rights Restriction
facts.sentence: An Employee has no unilateral withdrawal rights under the Endorsement Method split-dollar arrangement.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Threshold
facts.sentence: The minimum withdrawal amount is $10,000.

facts.name: Maximum Withdrawal Formula
facts.sentence: The maximum withdrawal amount is equal to the Account Value minus the Employer's Recoverable Amount minimum balance as required by the Split-Dollar Agreement.

facts.name: No Withdrawal Fee
facts.sentence: There is no withdrawal fee associated with any withdrawal.

facts.name: Withdrawal Reduces Account Value
facts.sentence: Each withdrawal reduces the Account Value.

facts.name: Withdrawal Impact on Family Benefit
facts.sentence: Each withdrawal may reduce the Employee's Family Benefit.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 85% of the Account Value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate Formula
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is the applicable Federal Rate (AFR) for mid-term loans, as published by the IRS on a monthly basis, plus 0.50%.

facts.name: Loan Interest Adjustment
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is adjusted quarterly.

facts.name: AFR Purpose in Loan Compliance
facts.sentence: The purpose of using the AFR is to ensure the loan does not constitute a below-market loan under IRC §7872.

facts.name: Below-Market Loan Consequences
facts.sentence: A below-market loan under IRC §7872 could trigger additional imputed income to the Employee.

facts.name: Loan Request Authority
facts.sentence: Only the Owner (Employer) may request loans against the policy.

facts.name: Loan Inclusion in Recoverable Amount
facts.sentence: Loans are included in the calculation of the Employer's Recoverable Amount under the Split-Dollar Agreement.

facts.sentence: Rollout refers to the termination of the split-dollar arrangement.

facts.name: Policy Ownership Transfer
facts.sentence: Rollout involves the transfer of policy ownership from Employer to Employee.

facts.sentence: Rollout can involve transfer of policy ownership from Employer to Employee's designee.

facts.name: ILIT as Designee Example

facts.sentence: Upon Rollout, the Employer is entitled to receive the Employer's Recoverable Amount.

facts.sentence: The Employer's Recoverable Amount must be received before ownership transfer.

facts.name: Recoverable Amount Timing
facts.sentence: The Employer's Recoverable Amount must be received simultaneously with ownership transfer.

facts.name: Scheduled Rollout Terms
facts.sentence: Scheduled rollout occurs per the terms of the Split-Dollar Agreement.

facts.sentence: Employee's termination of employment triggers Rollout.

facts.sentence: Employer's dissolution triggers Rollout.

facts.sentence: Employer's insolvency triggers Rollout.

facts.sentence: Mutual agreement between the parties triggers Rollout.

facts.sentence: Employees should consult tax counsel regarding potential tax consequences of Rollout.

facts.sentence: We will cooperate with ownership change requests.

facts.name: Transfer Form Requirement
facts.sentence: Ownership change requests must include a signed transfer form.

facts.sentence: The Surrender Charge Schedule applies as a percentage of the Specified Amount.

fact_fact.description: The policy’s supremacy clause ensures that its provision requiring receipt of the recoverable amount before transfer remains binding, reinforcing the validity of such procedural requirements despite potential inconsistencies in the parent agreement.

fact_fact.label: influences
fact_fact.description: The policy’s dominance in resolving disputes may affect how rollout triggers, such as employer insolvency, are interpreted or enforced under the agreement.

fact_fact.label: corroborates
fact_fact.description: The policy’s supremacy clause reinforces the validity of rollout mechanisms—including mutual agreement—as long as they align with the policy’s framework, which governs implementation details.

fact_fact.label: depends on
fact_fact.description: The policy’s supremacy clause ensures that even though surrender charges transfer upon rollout, those rules operate under the policy’s authoritative terms rather than potentially contradictory agreement language.

fact_fact.label: depends on
fact_fact.description: The policy’s rule that it takes precedence over conflicting agreement terms supports the exclusivity of the Employer’s right to initiate the illness acceleration rider, maintaining consistent control over benefits.

fact_fact.label: limited by
fact_fact.description: The policy’s supremacy clause limits the scope of exceptions like employee-triggered riders, meaning such powers cannot exist unless formally included in the policy despite being allowed by the agreement.

fact_fact.label: supersedes
fact_fact.description: While the second fact emphasizes the policy’s supremacy over the split-dollar agreement, the first provides foundational context—that the policy exists in conjunction with another agreement—making the hierarchical clause meaningful and legally grounded.

facts.name: Separate Account Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Separate Account' refers to Meridian Variable Life Account B.

facts.name: Segregated Asset Account
facts.sentence: Meridian Variable Life Account B is a segregated asset account of Meridian Life Insurance Company of New York.

facts.name: Segregated Asset Protection
facts.sentence: Meridian Variable Life Account B is insulated from the general account creditors of Meridian Life Insurance Company of New York.

facts.name: Sub-Account Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Sub-Account' is a subdivision of the Separate Account.

facts.name: Sub-Account Investments
facts.sentence: Each Sub-Account invests in shares of a designated underlying mutual fund.

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: The 'Account Value' is defined as the sum of all Sub-Account values plus any Fixed Account balance.

facts.name: Net Investment Factor Definition
facts.sentence: The 'Net Investment Factor' is the ratio used to calculate daily Sub-Account unit values.

facts.name: Net Investment Factor Definition
facts.sentence: The Net Investment Factor reflects investment performance and mortality and expense charges.

facts.name: Definition of No-Lapse Guarantee
facts.sentence: The term 'No-Lapse Guarantee' (NLG) is defined within Article 1 – Definitions.

facts.name: Net Investment Factor Definition
facts.sentence: The Net Investment Factor is a ratio used to calculate daily Sub-Account unit values.

facts.name: Net Investment Factor Performance
facts.sentence: The Net Investment Factor reflects investment performance.

facts.name: Net Investment Factor Charges
facts.sentence: The Net Investment Factor reflects mortality and expense charges.

facts.name: Contractual NLG Guarantee
facts.sentence: A No-Lapse Guarantee (NLG) is a contractual guarantee.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Protection
facts.sentence: The No-Lapse Guarantee ensures the policy will not lapse.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Condition
facts.sentence: The No-Lapse Guarantee applies provided cumulative NLG Premiums are satisfied.

facts.name: Minimum Premium Payment
facts.sentence: Premiums are subject to a minimum per payment amount of $100.

facts.name: Annual Premium Limit
facts.sentence: Premiums are subject to an annual maximum limit of $150,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Compliance
facts.sentence: The annual maximum premium limit of $150,000 complies with IRC §7702.

facts.name: Premium Expense Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: A premium expense charge of 4.5% is deducted from each premium before allocation.

facts.name: Premium Allocation Designation
facts.sentence: The owner designates premium allocation among Sub-Accounts and the Fixed Account.

facts.name: Premium Allocation Designation Location
facts.sentence: Premium allocation designation occurs on the Policy Data Page.

facts.name: Allocation Change Frequency
facts.sentence: Allocation changes are permitted up to two times per policy year at no charge.

facts.name: Additional Change Fee
facts.sentence: Each additional allocation change beyond two per policy year incurs a fee of $25.

facts.name: NLG Suspension Due to Underpayment
facts.sentence: If No-Lapse Guarantee Premium is underpaid in any month, the NLG is suspended.

facts.name: NLG Reinstatement Condition
facts.sentence: The NLG is reinstated when cumulative premiums paid return to the cumulative NLG Premium schedule.

facts.name: Equity Sub-Account Inclusion
facts.sentence: EQUITY SUB-ACCOUNTS include the MLY Growth Portfolio.

facts.name: MLY Growth Portfolio Focus
facts.sentence: The MLY Growth Portfolio focuses on Large Cap Growth investing.

facts.name: Equity Sub-Account Inclusion
facts.sentence: EQUITY SUB-ACCOUNTS include the MLY S&P 500 Index Portfolio.

facts.name: Equity Sub-Account Inclusion
facts.sentence: EQUITY SUB-ACCOUNTS include the MLY International Equity Portfolio.

facts.name: Equity Sub-Account Inclusion
facts.sentence: EQUITY SUB-ACCOUNTS include the MLY Small-Mid Cap Portfolio.

facts.name: Fixed Income Sub-Account Inclusion
facts.sentence: FIXED INCOME SUB-ACCOUNTS include the MLY Bond Income Portfolio.

facts.name: Sub-Account Investment Exclusivity
facts.sentence: Each Sub-Account invests exclusively in its named underlying portfolio.

facts.name: Portfolio Label Assignment
facts.sentence: The MLY International Equity Portfolio is labeled as (c).

facts.name: Label for Small-Mid Cap Portfolio
facts.sentence: The MLY Small-Mid Cap Portfolio is labeled as (d).

facts.name: Bond Income Portfolio Classification
facts.sentence: The MLY Bond Income Portfolio is categorized under Fixed Income Sub-accounts.

facts.name: MLY U.S. Government Portfolio Classification
facts.sentence: The MLY U.S. Government Portfolio is categorized under Fixed Income Sub-accounts.

facts.name: Managed Volatility Classification
facts.sentence: The MLY Managed Volatility Portfolio is categorized under Balanced/Other.

facts.name: Asset Allocation Category
facts.sentence: The MLY Asset Allocation Portfolio is categorized under Balanced/Other.

facts.name: Fixed Account Guarantee
facts.sentence: The Fixed Account offers a guaranteed minimum annual return of 2.00%.

facts.name: Fixed Account Return Rate
facts.sentence: The current annual return rate for the Fixed Account is 3.75%.

facts.name: Daily Market Fluctuations
facts.sentence: Sub-Account values fluctuate daily based on market performance.

facts.name: No Return Guarantee on Sub-Accounts
facts.sentence: No rate of return is guaranteed on Sub-Accounts.

facts.name: Right to Add Sub-Accounts
facts.sentence: We reserve the right to add new Sub-Accounts upon 30 days’ written notice to the Owner.

facts.name: Sub-Account Removal Right
facts.sentence: We reserve the right to remove existing Sub-Accounts upon 30 days’ written notice to the Owner.

facts.name: Right to Substitute Sub-Accounts
facts.sentence: We reserve the right to substitute Sub-Accounts upon 30 days’ written notice to the Owner.

facts.name: Sub-Account Changes Require Approval
facts.sentence: Any addition, removal, or substitution of Sub-Accounts requires regulatory approval.

facts.name: Access to Fund Prospectuses
facts.sentence: Underlying fund prospectuses are accessible via the website www.meridianlifeny.com/vul.

facts.name: Prospectus Availability via Request
facts.sentence: Underlying fund prospectuses can also be obtained upon written request.

facts.name: Daily Deduction of Fees
facts.sentence: Separate Account Charges are deducted daily from Sub-Accounts.

facts.name: Mortality & Expense Charge
facts.sentence: The Mortality & Expense Risk Charge is 0.60% per annum.

facts.name: Administrative Charge Rate
facts.sentence: The Administrative Charge is 0.15% per annum.

facts.name: Separate Fund Expenses
facts.sentence: Underlying fund expense ratios are charged separately within each portfolio.

facts.name: Expense Ratios in Prospectuses
facts.sentence: Fund prospectuses detail underlying fund expense ratios.

facts.name: Monthly Deduction Timing
facts.sentence: Monthly Policy Charges are deducted on the 15th of each month.

facts.name: Monthly COI Charge Application
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance (COI) charge is applied monthly and referenced in the COI Schedule.

facts.name: Monthly Admin Fee
facts.sentence: Policy administration fee is $10.00 per month.

facts.name: Unpaid Loan Interest Deduction
facts.sentence: Outstanding loan interest that remains unpaid is deducted monthly.

facts.name: COI Calculation Basis
facts.sentence: COI is calculated using the Net Amount at Risk.

facts.name: COI Calculation Basis
facts.sentence: The 2017 CSO Aggregate Unisex Table is used for calculating COI.

facts.name: COI Nonsmoker Rates
facts.sentence: Nonsmoker rates are used in the COI calculation method.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Embedded
facts.sentence: A No-Lapse Guarantee charge is not assessed separately.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Embedded Fee
facts.sentence: The No-Lapse Guarantee charge is embedded within the Mortality and Expense Charge.

facts.name: CSO Nonsmoker Rates
facts.sentence: The CSO Aggregate Unisex Table applies to nonsmokers.

facts.name: No-Lapse Charge Assessment
facts.sentence: A No-Lapse Guarantee charge is assessed separately.

facts.name: No-Lapse Charge Embedding
facts.sentence: The No-Lapse Guarantee charge is embedded in the mortality and expense charge.

facts.name: Current Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: Option A (Level) is currently selected as the death benefit option.

facts.name: Option A Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Under Option A, the death benefit equals the greater of the Specified Amount or the IRC §7702 corridor percentage of the Account Value.

facts.name: Option B Availability
facts.sentence: Option B (Increasing) is available upon request.

facts.name: Option B Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Under Option B, the death benefit equals the sum of the Specified Amount and the Account Value.

facts.name: Death Proceeds Funding Source
facts.sentence: Death proceeds are paid from the general account.

facts.name: Post-Death Proceeds Protection
facts.sentence: Death proceeds are not subject to market risk after the date of death.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Floor
facts.sentence: If the No-Lapse Guarantee is active, the death benefit is guaranteed to equal at least the Specified Amount.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Duration
facts.sentence: The guarantee under the No-Lapse Guarantee remains effective for the entire duration of the NLG Period.

facts.name: Account Transfer Flexibility
facts.sentence: The Owner may transfer Account Value among Sub-Accounts at any time.

facts.name: Transfer Flexibility Between Accounts
facts.sentence: The Owner may transfer Account Value between Sub-Accounts and the Fixed Account at any time.

facts.name: Fixed Account Transfer Limit
facts.sentence: Transfers from the Fixed Account are limited to a maximum of 25% of the Fixed Account balance per policy year.

facts.name: Free Transfer Allowance
facts.sentence: The first 12 transfers per year are free of charge.

facts.name: Transfer Fee Beyond Annual Limit
facts.sentence: Each transfer beyond the first 12 in a given year incurs a fee of $25.

facts.name: Market Timing Restrictions
facts.sentence: Market timing restrictions apply to prevent disruptive short-term trading.

facts.name: Insurer Transfer Discretion
facts.sentence: The insurer reserves the right to refuse transfer requests deemed by its sole discretion to constitute harmful short-term trading.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum partial withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: Maximum Partial Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum partial withdrawal amount is equal to the account value minus a $500 reserve.

facts.name: Max Withdrawal Excludes Fees
facts.sentence: The maximum partial withdrawal amount excludes any applicable surrender charges.

facts.name: Pro-Rata Withdrawal Rule
facts.sentence: Withdrawals are taken pro-rata from all sub-accounts and the fixed account unless the owner specifies otherwise.

facts.name: Withdrawal Fee Structure
facts.sentence: A withdrawal fee of $25 applies to each withdrawal made in years 1 through 10.

facts.name: Post-Year-10 Fee Exemption
facts.sentence: No withdrawal fee applies to withdrawals made after year 10.

facts.name: NLG Withdrawal Impact
facts.sentence: Withdrawing funds during the NLG period may reduce the NLG premium required to maintain the guarantee.

facts.name: Permanent NLG Reduction
facts.sentence: Withdrawals permanently reduce the NLG amount rather than suspending it.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan amount is 90% of the account value.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Exclusion
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan amount excludes amounts in sub-accounts that are pledged as collateral.

facts.name: Loan Collateral Transfer
facts.sentence: Loaned amounts are transferred to the fixed account as collateral.

facts.name: Fixed Account Collateral Interest
facts.sentence: Collateral in the fixed account earns interest at 2.00% per annum.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is fixed at 3.50% per annum.

facts.name: Net Loan Cost Calculation
facts.sentence: The net loan cost is calculated as 1.50%, which equals the difference between the interest charged and the interest credited on collateral.

facts.name: Loan-Induced Policy Lapse
facts.sentence: If outstanding loans cause the account value to reach zero, the policy lapses.

facts.name: NLG Limitation: Loan-Induced Lapse
facts.sentence: The NLG does not protect against policy lapse caused by outstanding loans.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Formula
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender Value equals Account Value minus Surrender Charge minus Outstanding Loans.

facts.name: Surrender Charges Timeline
facts.sentence: Surrender Charge applies to each premium payment within 10 years of payment.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: First Year
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 1 and 12, the surrender charge is 7% of the premium.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: 6% (Months 13–24)
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 13 and 24, the surrender charge is 6% of the premium.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: 5% (Months 25–36)
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 25 and 36, the surrender charge is 5% of the premium.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: 4% (Months 37–48)
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 37 and 48, the surrender charge is 4% of the premium.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: 3% (Months 49–60)
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 49 and 60, the surrender charge is 3% of the premium.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: 2% (Months 61–72)
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 61 and 72, the surrender charge is 2% of the premium.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: 1% (Months 73–84)
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 73 and 84, the surrender charge is 1% of the premium.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: 0.5% (Months 85–120)
facts.sentence: For premiums paid between months 85 and 120, the surrender charge is 0.5% of the premium.

facts.name: Zero Surrender Charge After 120 Months
facts.sentence: After 120 months from each premium payment, the surrender charge is 0%.

facts.name: NLG Void Upon Full Surrender
facts.sentence: The NLG is void upon full surrender.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Limitation
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide within 24 months of issue, the death benefit is limited to the Account Value as of the date of death.

facts.name: Sub-Account Gains Included
facts.sentence: Account Value includes any Sub-Account gains as of the date of death.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Benefit
facts.sentence: There is no deduction for surrender charges when calculating the death benefit under the suicide exclusion.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: We may contest claims based on material misrepresentation within 2 years of the issue date.

facts.name: Right to Examine
facts.sentence: The owner has 30 days from receipt of the policy to return it for a full refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Grace Period Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: A 61-day grace period begins when Account Value is insufficient to pay monthly charges.

facts.name: Grace Period Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: The NLG is not active when a 61-day grace period begins due to insufficient Account Value.

facts.name: Grace Period Notification Process
facts.sentence: Notice is sent to the Owner's address of record during the 61-day grace period.

facts.name: NLG Active Exemption

facts.sentence: The Specified Amount (Face Value) of the policy is $3,000,000.

facts.name: Planned Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The Planned Premium for the policy is $8,500 per month.

facts.name: Minimum Monthly Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: The Minimum Premium required for the policy is $4,100 per month.

facts.name: Target Monthly Premium

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit Option selected is Level (Option A).

facts.name: Estate Tax Funding Purpose
facts.sentence: The purpose of the policy’s proceeds is to fund federal estate tax liability upon the death of the surviving Insured.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary: ILIT
facts.sentence: The Primary Beneficiary of the policy is The Beaumont Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Ownership
facts.sentence: The Primary Beneficiary holds a 100% share of the benefits.

facts.name: Policy Owner = ILIT
facts.sentence: The same entity that owns the policy also operates as The Beaumont Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The Contingent Beneficiary of the policy is The Beaumont Children's Trust.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Ownership
facts.sentence: The Contingent Beneficiary holds a 100% share of the benefits.

facts.name: ILIT as Policy Owner
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner is an Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust (ILIT).

facts.name: Estate Exclusion via ILIT
facts.sentence: Proceeds received by the trust are intended to be excluded from the gross estates of both Insureds.

facts.name: Proceeds Exclusion Conditions
facts.sentence: Exclusion of proceeds from gross estates is subject to applicable IRS rules regarding incidents of ownership.

facts.name: Three-Year Lookback Rule Compliance
facts.sentence: Exclusion of proceeds from gross estates is subject to the three-year lookback rule under IRC §2035.

facts.name: Last Surviving Insured Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Last Surviving Insured' refers to the Insured who dies after the other Insured.

facts.name: Definition of First Death
facts.sentence: The term 'First Death' refers to the death of the first Insured to die.

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Account Value' refers to the sum of accumulated premiums, plus credited interest, minus monthly charges since issuance.

facts.name: Waiver Period Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Waiver Period' refers to the time interval following First Death during which certain charges are adjusted.

facts.name: Waiver Period Reference
facts.sentence: The Waiver Period details can be found in Article 3.

facts.name: COI Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'COI' stands for the joint Cost of Insurance charge.

facts.name: COI Based on Combined Ages
facts.sentence: The COI is calculated based on the combined ages of both Insureds.

facts.name: COI Based on Joint Mortality Rates
facts.sentence: The COI is calculated based on the mortality rates of both Insureds.

facts.name: Joint COI Charge Definition
facts.sentence: COI refers to the joint Cost of Insurance charge.

facts.name: COI Based on Both Ages
facts.sentence: COI is calculated based on both Insureds' ages.

facts.name: COI Calculation Basis
facts.sentence: COI is calculated based on mortality rates.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Condition
facts.sentence: Surrender Charge applies if the policy is surrendered within 20 years of issue.

facts.name: Flexible Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums may be paid at any frequency.

facts.name: Flexible Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums may be paid at any amount.

facts.name: Minimum Payment Threshold
facts.sentence: Minimum premium payment per payment is $500.

facts.name: Annual Premium Maximum Limit
facts.sentence: Annual maximum premium payment is $750,000.

facts.name: MEC Limits Apply to Annual Max
facts.sentence: MEC limits apply to the annual maximum premium payment of $750,000.

facts.name: Premium Evidence Requirement
facts.sentence: Additional premium payments may require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Premium Expense Load
facts.sentence: A premium expense load of 2.5% applies to each premium payment.

facts.name: ILIT Ownership Design
facts.sentence: This policy is designed to be owned by an ILIT.

facts.name: Grantor Gift Tax Exclusion Eligibility
facts.sentence: Premium payments by Grantors may qualify for the gift tax annual exclusion.

facts.name: Crummey Rights Requirement
facts.sentence: Grantor premium payments qualify for the gift tax annual exclusion only if the Trust instrument contains valid Crummey withdrawal powers.

facts.name: Tax Treatment Disclaimer
facts.sentence: We make no representation regarding the tax treatment of contributions.

facts.name: Tax Advice for Policy Owners
facts.sentence: Policyholders should consult an estate planning attorney regarding tax implications.

facts.name: Post-First-Death Premium Adjustment
facts.sentence: After First Death, the premium payment obligation may be modified.

facts.name: Post-First-Death Premium Changes
facts.sentence: Modifications to the premium payment obligation occur as described in Article 3.

facts.name: MEC Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: If premiums exceed the 7-pay limit under IRC §7702A, this policy becomes a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC).

facts.name: MEC Status & Death Benefit
facts.sentence: MEC status does not affect the death benefit.

facts.name: MEC Tax Treatment
facts.sentence: MEC status subjects loans and withdrawals to income tax.

facts.name: MEC Penalty on Withdrawals
facts.sentence: MEC status subjects loans and withdrawals to a possible 10% penalty.

facts.name: MEC Status Notification
facts.sentence: We will notify the policyholder if a premium would cause MEC status.

facts.name: Surviving Insured Name Basis
facts.sentence: Upon First Death, the surviving Insured's name becomes part of the basis for ongoing COI calculations.

facts.name: Surviving Insured DOB in COI Basis
facts.sentence: Upon First Death, the surviving Insured's date of birth becomes part of the basis for ongoing COI calculations.

facts.name: Surviving Insured Risk Class Basis
facts.sentence: Upon First Death, the surviving Insured's risk class becomes part of the basis for ongoing COI calculations.

facts.name: Post-Death COI Basis
facts.sentence: After First Death, the surviving Insured’s name, DOB, and risk class serve as the sole basis for ongoing COI calculations.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Inclusion
facts.sentence: Premium Waiver on First Death is included at no additional charge.

facts.name: COI Waiver After First Death
facts.sentence: All monthly COI charges are waived for 12 months following First Death.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Purpose
facts.sentence: The Premium Waiver applies to provide Owner premium relief during estate settlement.

facts.name: Post-Waiver Deduction Resumption
facts.sentence: After the 12-month waiver period, regular monthly deductions resume.

facts.name: Post-Waiver Age-Based Deductions
facts.sentence: Post-waiver monthly deductions are based on the surviving Insured's attained age.

facts.name: Post-Waiver Deduction Basis
facts.sentence: Post-waiver monthly deductions are based on current COI rates.

facts.name: Post-Death Premium Rights
facts.sentence: The Owner retains the right to make premium payments after First Death.

facts.name: Loan Rights Post-Death
facts.sentence: The Owner retains the right to take loans after First Death.

facts.name: Withdrawal Rights Post-Death
facts.sentence: The Owner retains the right to make withdrawals after First Death.

facts.name: Monthly Deduction Process
facts.sentence: On the 1st of each month, the insurer deducts from Account Value.

facts.name: Monthly Joint COI Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 1st of each month, the insurer deducts the Joint COI charge (pre-First Death).

facts.name: Joint COI Calculation Method
facts.sentence: Pre-First Death Joint COI charge is calculated using the last-survivor mortality table.

facts.name: Joint COI Charge Calculation
facts.sentence: Pre-First Death Joint COI charge uses both Insureds’ ages simultaneously.

facts.name: Monthly Administrative Fee Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 1st of each month, the insurer deducts an administrative fee of $15.00.

facts.name: Monthly Loan Interest Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 1st of each month, the insurer deducts outstanding loan interest.

facts.name: Single Life COI Calculation
facts.sentence: Post-First Death COI is calculated on a single life basis.

facts.name: Post-Death COI Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: Post-First Death COI equals (Specified Amount minus Account Value) multiplied by the Monthly COI Rate for the surviving Insured divided by 1,000.

facts.name: COI Rate Cap Guarantee
facts.sentence: COI rates are guaranteed not to exceed the maximum rates listed in the attached Joint Last-Survivor COI Schedule.

facts.name: Daily Interest Credit
facts.sentence: Interest is credited daily.

facts.name: Guaranteed Minimum Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum annual interest rate is 2.25%.

facts.name: Current Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The current credited annual interest rate is 4.00%.

facts.name: Tiered Interest Rates
facts.sentence: Different interest rates may be applied based on account value tiers.

facts.name: Tier 1 Account Value Range
facts.sentence: Tier 1 includes accounts with up to $500,000 in account value.

facts.name: Tier 1 Rate Application
facts.sentence: The current credited rate applies to Tier 1.

facts.name: Tier 2 Account Valuation Range
facts.sentence: Tier 2 includes accounts valued between $500,001 and $2,000,000.

facts.name: Tier 2 Interest Rate Addition
facts.sentence: The interest rate for Tier 2 is the current credited rate plus 0.25 percentage points.

facts.name: Tier 3 Account Threshold
facts.sentence: Tier 3 includes accounts valued above $2,000,000.

facts.name: Tier 3 Interest Rate Addition
facts.sentence: The interest rate for Tier 3 is the current credited rate plus 0.50 percentage points.

facts.name: Changing Tiered Rates
facts.sentence: Tiered interest rates are subject to change over time.

facts.name: Guaranteed Rate Uniformity Across Tiers
facts.sentence: Guaranteed minimum interest rates apply to all account value tiers.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The death benefit is payable only when the last surviving insured dies.

facts.name: First Death No Payout
facts.sentence: No death benefit is paid upon the first death.

facts.name: Policy Continuation After First Death
facts.sentence: The policy remains in force after the first death occurs.

facts.name: Death Benefit Equals Specified Amount
facts.sentence: The death benefit equals the specified amount under Level Option A.

facts.name: Minimum Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The minimum death benefit is the greater of the specified amount or 101% of the account value at the time of the last surviving insured’s death.

facts.name: Loan Reduction of Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Outstanding policy loans reduce the death benefit.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Rule
facts.sentence: If both insured individuals die in a common accident, they are considered to have died simultaneously.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Rule
facts.sentence: If both insured individuals die within 24 hours of each other, they are treated as having died simultaneously.

facts.name: Last Survivor Determination
facts.sentence: When two insureds die simultaneously, the last surviving insured is determined by comparing their respective account value allocations.

facts.name: Higher Allocation Determines Survivor
facts.sentence: The insured with the higher account value allocation is deemed the last surviving insured.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum partial withdrawal amount is $1,000.

facts.name: Max Annual Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum annual partial withdrawal is 10% of the Account Value.

facts.name: Max Annual Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum annual partial withdrawal is subject to the greater of 10% of the Account Value or any applicable surrender charge.

facts.name: No Withdrawal Fee
facts.sentence: There is no withdrawal fee in any policy year.

facts.name: Account Value Reduction
facts.sentence: Withdrawals reduce the Account Value.

facts.name: Account Value Threshold Notification
facts.sentence: If the Account Value falls below the total of 12 months of projected monthly deductions, the insurer will notify the Trustee.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan amount is 80% of the Account Value.

facts.name: Loan Limit Reduction Due to Estate Planning
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan amount was reduced from 90% due to estate planning context.

facts.name: Loan Limit Reduction Due to Trust Complexity
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan amount was reduced from 90% due to the complexity of Trustee borrowing authority.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate is fixed at 5.00% per annum.

facts.name: Loan Interest Credited Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest is credited on collateral at 4.00% per annum.

facts.name: Net Cost of Borrowing
facts.sentence: The net cost of borrowing is 1.00% per annum.

facts.name: Trustee Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: Any loan request must be accompanied by a certification from the Trustee.

facts.name: Trustee Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: The Trustee certification must confirm that the loan is authorized under the Trust instrument.

facts.name: Trustee Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: The Trustee certification must confirm that the loan is authorized under applicable state law.

facts.name: Insurer Not Responsible for Trustee Authority
facts.sentence: The insurer is not responsible for the validity of the Trustee's borrowing authority.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Calculation
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender Value equals Account Value minus Surrender Charge minus Outstanding Loans.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Formula
facts.sentence: Cash surrender value equals account value minus surrender charge minus outstanding loans.

facts.name: Surrender Charges: Years 1–2
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 1–2 are 9% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charges: Years 3–4
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 3–4 are 7% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charges: Years 5–6
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 5–6 are 5% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charges: Years 7–8
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 7–8 are 4% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charges: Years 9–10
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 9–10 are 3% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charges: Years 11–15
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 11–15 are 2% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charges: Years 16–20
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 16–20 are 1% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Zero Surrender Charges After Year 21
facts.sentence: Surrender charges during Years 21+ are 0% of the specified amount.

facts.name: Long-Term Estate Planning
facts.sentence: The extended 20-year surrender charge schedule reflects the long-term estate planning nature of this insurance product.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Condition
facts.sentence: If an insured dies by suicide within 24 months of issue, the death benefit is replaced by a return of account value only if that insured is the last surviving insured.

facts.name: First Suicide No Policy Impact
facts.sentence: A first death by suicide has no effect on policy terms.

facts.name: Contestability Period per Insured
facts.sentence: Each insured’s application may be contested separately within 2 years of issue.

facts.name: Community Property Impact
facts.sentence: If the insureds reside in a community property state, community property rights may affect policy ownership.

facts.name: Community Property Impact on Beneficiaries
facts.sentence: If the insureds reside in a community property state, community property rights may affect beneficiary designations.

facts.name: Estate Attorney Consultation Recommendation
facts.sentence: It is recommended to consult with an estate attorney regarding community property implications.

facts.name: Trustee Notification Trigger
facts.sentence: If the account value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions, the trusteed is notified.

facts.name: Grace Period Notification Trigger
facts.sentence: If Account Value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions, a notice is sent to the Trustee.

facts.name: Grace Period Trigger
facts.sentence: When Account Value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions, the policy enters a 61-day grace period.

facts.name: Lapse Consequences for Estate Planning
facts.sentence: A lapse of a survivorship policy may result in unintended estate planning consequences.

facts.name: Trustee Notification Duty
facts.sentence: We strongly encourage the Trustee to notify the Grantors immediately upon receiving a grace period notice.

facts.name: Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement of a lapsed policy is possible within 5 years of lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Condition
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability of the surviving Insured is required for reinstatement, if applicable.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Overdue charges must be paid for reinstatement.

facts.name: Execution Location
facts.sentence: This policy was executed at Omaha, Nebraska.

facts.name: President Signed Policy
facts.sentence: The President of Heartland Heritage Life Insurance signed the policy.

facts.name: Policy Effective Date
facts.sentence: The policy was dated April 1, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Form Number
facts.sentence: The policy form number is HHL-SUL-24.

facts.name: Survivorship Basis Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is issued on a survivorship basis.

facts.name: State Variations Apply
facts.sentence: State variations may apply to this policy.

facts.name: Policy Issuer Identification
facts.sentence: The Universal Life Insurance Policy with Long-Term Care Acceleration Benefit Rider is issued by Sequoia Benefits & Life Company.

facts.name: Policy Contract Identifier
facts.sentence: The contract number for this policy is SBL-UL-LTC-24-00341.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: This policy was issued on May 20, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Owner and Insured Identity
facts.sentence: Patricia Noreen Halverson is both the policy owner and the insured person.

facts.name: Female Insured Gender
facts.sentence: The gender of the insured person is female.

facts.name: Date of Birth Confirmation
facts.sentence: The date of birth of the insured person is May 12, 1958.

facts.name: Insured Age: 66
facts.sentence: The current age of the insured person is 66 years old.

facts.name: Standard Plus Nonsmoker Classification
facts.sentence: The risk classification of the insured person is Standard Plus Nonsmoker.

facts.name: Policy Face Value
facts.sentence: The specified amount (face value) of the policy is $250,000.

facts.name: Single Premium Design
facts.sentence: The premium design for this policy is single premium.

facts.name: Single Premium Payment
facts.sentence: The total single premium paid for this policy is $95,000.

facts.name: Return of Premium Enhanced
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected for this policy is Return of Premium Enhanced (Option C).

facts.name: MEC Classification Under IRC §7702A
facts.sentence: This policy is classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC §7702A.

facts.name: Loan Taxation Under MEC
facts.sentence: Policy loans made against this policy are subject to ordinary income tax.

facts.name: Policy Withdrawal Tax Treatment
facts.sentence: Withdrawals from this policy are subject to ordinary income tax.

facts.name: Early Withdrawal Penalty Tax
facts.sentence: Any policy loan or withdrawal taken before age 59½ may be subject to a 10% federal penalty tax.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Harold J. Halverson is designated as the primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Spouse Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Harold J. Halverson is married to the insured.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: Harold J. Halverson receives 60% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Trust Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Halverson Family Revocable Trust is designated as a primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: Halverson Family Revocable Trust receives 40% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Cynthia L. Park is designated as a contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Daughter Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Cynthia L. Park is the daughter of the insured.

facts.name: Contingent Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Cynthia L. Park receives 50% of the death benefit if no primary beneficiaries survive.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Brett A. Halverson is designated as a contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Son of Insured
facts.sentence: Brett A. Halverson is the son of the insured.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Inheritance
facts.sentence: Brett A. Halverson receives 50% of the death benefit if no primary beneficiaries survive.

facts.name: Attached LTC Rider
facts.sentence: The Long-Term Care Acceleration Benefit Rider is attached to the policy.

facts.name: Rider Incorporation by Reference
facts.sentence: The Long-Term Care Acceleration Benefit Rider is incorporated by reference.

facts.name: Rider Form Identification
facts.sentence: The Long-Term Care Acceleration Benefit Rider uses Form SBL-LTC-R.

facts.name: NAIC Compliance Framework
facts.sentence: The Long-Term Care Acceleration Benefit Rider is governed by NAIC Long-Term Care Model Act provisions.

facts.name: NAIC Model Act Compliance
facts.sentence: The NAIC Long-Term Care Model Act provisions apply as adopted in the state of issue.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Pool Amount
facts.sentence: The LTC Benefit Pool is equal to $250,000.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Pool Equals Specified Amount
facts.sentence: The LTC Benefit Pool is equal to the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Monthly LTC Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The Monthly LTC Benefit Maximum is 2% of the original Specified Amount.

facts.name: Monthly LTC Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: The Monthly LTC Benefit Maximum equals $5,000 per month.

facts.name: Elimination Period Duration
facts.sentence: The Elimination Period for the rider is 90 days of qualifying care services.

facts.name: Inflation Protection Terms
facts.sentence: Inflation protection applies at 3% simple annual increase to the monthly maximum.

facts.name: Two ADLs Required for Trigger
facts.sentence: A qualifying trigger requires any two of six Activities of Daily Living (ADLs).

facts.name: Six Triggering ADLs
facts.sentence: The six ADLs that can serve as triggering events are bathing, dressing, eating, continence, toileting, and transferring.

facts.name: Cognitive Impairment Trigger
facts.sentence: Severe cognitive impairment qualifies as a triggering condition when certified by a licensed healthcare practitioner.

facts.name: Eligible Care Setting: Nursing Facility
facts.sentence: Licensed nursing facilities are eligible qualifying care settings.

facts.name: State-Licensed Assisted Living Eligibility
facts.sentence: Assisted living facilities that are state licensed are eligible qualifying care settings.

facts.name: Eligible Home Health Care Requirement
facts.sentence: Home health care requiring minimum three visits per week is an eligible qualifying care setting.

facts.name: Eligible Care Setting: Adult Day Care
facts.sentence: Adult day care centers are eligible qualifying care settings.

facts.name: Tax-Free LTC Benefits
facts.sentence: LTC benefits paid under this rider are intended to qualify as tax-free under Internal Revenue Code Section 7702B(a).

facts.name: Tax Advisor Consultation Required
facts.sentence: Insured persons should consult a tax advisor regarding the tax treatment of LTC benefits.

facts.name: Benefit Reduction Rule
facts.sentence: Each dollar of LTC benefit paid reduces the Specified Amount dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Pool Reduction
facts.sentence: Each dollar of LTC benefit paid reduces the LTC Benefit Pool dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Tax-Free Qualification
facts.sentence: The rider is intended to qualify as tax-free under IRC §7702B(a).

facts.name: Tax Advisory Requirement
facts.sentence: Insured individuals should consult a tax advisor regarding the tax implications of the rider.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Reduces Specified Amount
facts.sentence: Each dollar of long-term care (LTC) benefit paid reduces the Specified Amount dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Pool Reduction
facts.sentence: Each dollar of long-term care (LTC) benefit paid reduces the LTC Benefit Pool dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Policy Termination on LTC Exhaustion
facts.sentence: When the LTC Benefit Pool is exhausted, the policy terminates.

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: Account Value means the single premium paid, plus credited interest, minus all charges and distributions.

facts.name: Option C Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: Option C (Return of Premium Enhanced) Death Benefit means the greater of: (a) the Specified Amount, or (b) the greater of the total premiums paid or Account Value multiplied by 1.10.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Pool Definition
facts.sentence: LTC Benefit Pool means the total amount available for long-term care acceleration.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Pool Definition
facts.sentence: LTC Benefit Pool equals the original Specified Amount reduced by prior LTC claims paid.

facts.name: Elimination Period Definition
facts.sentence: Elimination Period means the waiting period of continuous qualifying care before LTC benefits begin.

facts.name: ADL Definition
facts.sentence: ADL means Activity of Daily Living.

facts.name: Single Lump-Sum Funding
facts.sentence: This policy is funded by a single lump-sum premium.

facts.name: Single-Premium Design
facts.sentence: No further premiums are required or expected for this policy.

facts.name: Post-Issue Premium Acceptance
facts.sentence: Additional premiums are not accepted after the issue date unless prior underwriting approval is obtained.

facts.name: Premium Acceptance Restrictions
facts.sentence: Additional premiums may not be accepted if they would alter Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) status undesirably.

facts.name: Single Premium Allocation
facts.sentence: The entire single premium is allocated to the general account upon receipt.

facts.name: Premium Expense Load
facts.sentence: A premium expense load of 1.0% is deducted from the single premium before crediting interest.

facts.name: Premium Expense Load Deduction
facts.sentence: A premium expense load of 1.0% is deducted before crediting to the account upon receipt.

facts.name: No Ongoing Premiums Required
facts.sentence: No ongoing premiums are required for this policy.

facts.name: No Planned Premium
facts.sentence: There is no planned premium applicable to this policy.

facts.name: No Target Premium Applicable
facts.sentence: There is no target premium applicable to this policy.

facts.name: No Minimum Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: There is no minimum monthly premium applicable to this policy.

facts.name: Monthly COI Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 20th of each month, a cost of insurance charge is deducted from the Account Value.

facts.name: LTC Rider Monthly Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 20th of each month, an LTC Rider charge of $18.50 per month is deducted from the Account Value.

facts.name: LTC Rider Charge Cap
facts.sentence: The LTC Rider charge is guaranteed not to exceed $31.00 per month through age 85.

facts.name: Monthly Administrative Fee Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 20th of each month, an administrative fee of $7.00 per month is deducted from the Account Value.

facts.name: COI Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance (COI) is calculated using the formula: (Specified Amount Remaining - Account Value) × COI Rate / 1,000.

facts.name: LTC Claims Reduce Net Risk
facts.sentence: As the Specified Amount is reduced by Long-Term Care (LTC) claims, the net amount at risk decreases.

facts.name: Decreasing COI with LTC Claims
facts.sentence: As the net amount at risk decreases due to LTC claims, the Cost of Insurance (COI) also decreases.

facts.name: Monthly Interest Crediting
facts.sentence: Interest is credited monthly to the Account Value.

facts.name: Guaranteed Minimum Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum annual interest rate is 3.00%.

facts.name: Current Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The current credited annual interest rate is 4.50%.

facts.name: Higher Guaranteed Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The single-premium design enables the offering of a higher guaranteed minimum interest rate compared to multi-pay products.

facts.name: Annual Interest Rate Declaration
facts.sentence: The current interest rate is declared annually on January 1st.

facts.name: Annual Interest Rate Stability
facts.sentence: The current interest rate applied on January 1st applies to all Account Value throughout the entire calendar year.

facts.name: Option C Active
facts.sentence: Option C (Return of Premium Enhanced) is in force.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: The death benefit equals the greatest of: (a) current specified amount reduced by LTC claims, (b) total single premium paid of $95,000, or (c) account value multiplied by 1.10.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction Due to LTC Payments
facts.sentence: If LTC benefits have been paid, the death benefit is reduced by the total LTC benefits paid.

facts.name: Minimum Death Benefit Floor
facts.sentence: The minimum death benefit is 10% of the original specified amount, which is $25,000.

facts.name: Minimum Death Benefit Condition
facts.sentence: The minimum death benefit applies so long as the LTC Benefit Pool is not fully exhausted.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Timeline
facts.sentence: Death benefit proceeds are paid within 14 business days of receiving a certified death certificate and a completed claim form.

facts.name: Initiating LTC Benefits Procedure
facts.sentence: To initiate LTC benefits, the Owner must submit a written claim form designated Form SBL-LTC-C1.

facts.name: LTC Claim Physician Statement Requirement
facts.sentence: To initiate LTC benefits, the Owner must submit an attending physician statement certifying activities of daily living (ADL) impairments or cognitive impairment.

facts.name: Initiating LTC Benefits Requirement
facts.sentence: To initiate LTC benefits, the Owner must submit a plan of care from a licensed healthcare practitioner.

facts.name: Initiating LTC Benefits Requirements
facts.sentence: To initiate LTC benefits, the Owner must submit proof of qualifying care setting.

facts.name: Claim Response Timeline
facts.sentence: We will respond to a complete claim within 10 business days with a benefit determination.

facts.name: LTC Payment Recipient
facts.sentence: Monthly LTC benefits are paid directly to the Owner.

facts.name: LTC Payment Options
facts.sentence: Monthly LTC benefits can also be paid to the licensed care provider at the Owner’s election.

facts.name: Concurrent Care Re-Certification
facts.sentence: Concurrent Care Review requires re-certification of qualifying status every 12 months.

facts.name: LTC Benefits Cease on Recovery
facts.sentence: If the Insured recovers and no longer meets qualifying criteria, LTC benefits cease.

facts.name: Preserved LTC Benefit Pool
facts.sentence: Remaining LTC Benefit Pool is preserved for future qualifying periods.

facts.name: Annual Qualifying Certification
facts.sentence: The Insured must certify their qualifying status every 12 months.

facts.name: LTC Benefits Termination Upon Recovery
facts.sentence: If the Insured recovers and no longer meets qualifying criteria, Long-Term Care (LTC) benefits cease.

facts.name: LTC Benefit Pool Preservation
facts.sentence: Remaining LTC Benefit Pool is preserved for future qualifying periods.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Minimum withdrawal amount is $1,000.

facts.name: Withdrawals Taxed as Income First
facts.sentence: All withdrawals are treated as income first under Internal Revenue Code Section 72(e).

facts.name: Early Withdrawal Penalty Tax
facts.sentence: Withdrawals made before age 59½ may incur a 10% federal penalty tax.

facts.name: No withdrawal charges for single-pay
facts.sentence: There are no withdrawal charges on a single-pay policy.

facts.name: No surrender charge post-year 5
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies after year 5.

facts.name: Year 1 Surrender Charge
facts.sentence: Surrender charge in Year 1 is 5%.

facts.name: Year 2 Surrender Charge
facts.sentence: Surrender charge in Year 2 is 4%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge in Year 3
facts.sentence: Surrender charge in Year 3 is 3%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge in Year 4
facts.sentence: Surrender charge in Year 4 is 2%.

facts.name: Year 5 Surrender Charge
facts.sentence: Surrender charge in Year 5 is 1%.

facts.name: Zero surrender charge after Year 6
facts.sentence: Surrender charge in Year 6 and beyond is 0%.

facts.name: Withdrawals Reduce Account Value
facts.sentence: Withdrawals reduce the Account Value.

facts.name: Withdrawals Reduce Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Withdrawals may reduce the death benefit under Option C.

facts.name: Max Loan Amount Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum loan amount is 90% of Account Value.

facts.name: Policy Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate is 4.00% per annum.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate is fixed.

facts.name: MEC Loans Treated as Distributions
facts.sentence: Policy loans from a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) are treated as distributions.

facts.name: MEC Loan Tax Treatment
facts.sentence: Policy loans from a MEC are taxable as ordinary income to the extent of gain in the policy.

facts.name: MEC Loan Penalty Tax
facts.sentence: Policy loans from a MEC may be subject to a 10% federal penalty tax before age 59½.

facts.name: Loan Reduces Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Outstanding loan reduces the death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Loan Exclusion from LTC Pool
facts.sentence: Outstanding loan is excluded from the LTC Benefit Pool balance.

facts.name: Early Withdrawal Penalty
facts.sentence: A federal penalty tax applies to distributions made before age 59½.

facts.name: Loan Reduces Death Benefit
facts.sentence: An outstanding loan reduces the death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Loan Exclusion from LTC Pool
facts.sentence: An outstanding loan is excluded from the Long-Term Care (LTC) Benefit Pool balance.

facts.name: Suicide Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: Death by suicide within 24 months of issue results in proceeds being limited to premiums paid, without interest.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: We may contest claims within 2 years of issue.

facts.name: LTC Exclusion: Self-Inflicted Injury
facts.sentence: No LTC benefits are payable for long-term care resulting from intentionally self-inflicted injury.

facts.name: Alcoholism Exclusion
facts.sentence: No LTC benefits are payable for care caused by alcoholism.

facts.name: LTC Exclusion: Drug Addiction
facts.sentence: No LTC benefits are payable for care caused by drug addiction.

facts.name: Family Member Care Exclusion
facts.sentence: No LTC benefits are payable when care is provided by an immediate family member unless that person is a licensed care provider.

facts.name: LTC Coverage Limitation – Foreign Care
facts.sentence: No LTC benefits are payable for care outside the United States or its territories except for emergency care up to 30 days per year.

facts.name: War-related care exclusion
facts.sentence: No LTC benefits are payable for care resulting from an act of war, whether declared or undeclared.

facts.name: Pre-Existing Condition Waiting Period
facts.sentence: LTC benefits for pre-existing conditions diagnosed or treated in the 12 months prior to issue are subject to a 6-month waiting period from the issue date.

facts.name: Single-Premium Lapse Protection
facts.sentence: Given the single-premium design, lapse due to nonpayment is unlikely.

facts.name: Account Value Notification Trigger
facts.sentence: If the Account Value is reduced by charges, LTC benefits, or withdrawals to an amount insufficient to cover 2 months of monthly deductions, we notify the Owner.

facts.name: 61-Day Premium Payment Window
facts.sentence: The Owner has 61 days from receipt of notice to submit a premium payment.

facts.name: Non-guaranteed Additional Premiums
facts.sentence: Additional premiums beyond the initial payment are not guaranteed to be accepted without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Monthly Deductions
facts.sentence: Monthly deductions are made from the policy.

facts.name: Owner Notification Trigger
facts.sentence: The Owner is notified when monthly deductions occur.

facts.name: Premium Payment Window
facts.sentence: The Owner has 61 days from receipt of notice to submit a premium payment.

facts.name: Premium Acceptance Limitation
facts.sentence: No additional premiums are guaranteed to be accepted by the insurer.

facts.name: Premium Acceptance Condition
facts.sentence: Additional premiums may only be accepted if evidence of insurability is provided.

facts.name: LTC Rider Termination Condition
facts.sentence: The LTC Rider terminates upon full exhaustion of the LTC Benefit Pool.

facts.name: Base Policy Continuation
facts.sentence: After termination of the LTC Rider, the base policy remains in force.

facts.name: Residual Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The residual death benefit under the base policy is equal to 10% of the original Specified Amount.

facts.name: Policy Execution Location
facts.sentence: This policy was executed in Hartford, Connecticut.

facts.name: Policy Execution Authority
facts.sentence: The President & Chief Underwriting Officer of Sequoia Benefits & Life Company signed the policy.

facts.name: Company Signature Authority
facts.sentence: The signature appears on the document titled 'Sequoia Benefits & Life Company'.

facts.name: Execution Date
facts.sentence: The date of execution is May 20, 2024.

facts.name: State Approval Status
facts.sentence: This policy and LTC Rider are approved for sale in the state of issue.

facts.name: Geographic Availability Limitation
facts.sentence: This policy and LTC Rider are not available in all states.
